2030 Goal: Scope 1 and 2 GHG 
Emissions
Description. Drive a 10% reduction in our absolute 
Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions from 2020 to 2030. 
Baseline. Progress measured as percent reduction 
from our calendar year 2019 emissions. Our  
combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions  
in 2019 were 2.88 million metric tons of CO2e.  
Progress in 2021. During 2021, our Scope 1 and 2 
emissions increased by approximately 14% from the 
2019 baseline.
Looking Ahead. In 2022, we will continue to take 
action to reduce emissions through abatement, 
investments in renewable electricity, process and 
equipment optimization, and energy conservation.  
In addition to this 2030 goal, in April 2022 we  
announced a new commitment to reach net zero 
Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 2040. Next year  
we will begin reporting progress toward both the 
2030 and 2040 commitments.
